kashika: हेतोः प्रयोगो हेतुप्रयोगः। हेतुशब्दस्य प्रयोगे हेतौ द्योत्ये षष्ठी विभक्तिर्भवति। अन्नस्य हेतोर्वसति॥
kashikaEnglish: When हेतु is used, the cause takes genitive: अन्नस्य हेतोर्वसति 'he dwells for the sake of food'.
englishFull:
When the word हेतु "cause" is explicitly used with a causal noun, that noun takes the 6th case-affix (genitive).

**Example:**
अन्नस्य हेतोर् वसति "he dwells for the sake of food"

The presence of हेतु itself triggers genitive.
